UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private player profile and synced UI preferences for a signed-in Life & Legacy player.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Google display name shown in the topbar player chip.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile or settings update.

SaveSlot.title: SaveSlot
SaveSlot.description: An autosave or manual save slot storing a sanitized Life & Legacy game state as a native map.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

slotId.description: Slot identifier: auto or slot0 through slot6.

savedAt.description: Client epoch timestamp in milliseconds used for newer-wins sync merging.

summaryName.description: Character full name for slot summary display.

summaryMoney.description: Character cash balance at save time.

summaryStatus.description: Alive status or cause of death summary.

state.description: Native Firestore map of the sanitized character and world state.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the save slot document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest save write.

AchievementsRecord.title: AchievementsRecord
AchievementsRecord.description: Cross-life unlocked achievements synced for a signed-in player.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

unlocked.description: Native map keyed by achievement ID containing unlock timestamp and life label.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the achievements document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest achievements merge.

/users/{userId}.description: Private player profile and preferences document owned strictly by userId.

/users/{userId}/saves/{slotId}.description: Player autosave (auto) and 7 manual save slots (slot0..slot6).
